anya_sales: Quick Q — ACME wants clarity on the VPC/on‑prem platform fee for their POC. They expect one POC invoice + a one-time platform fee. Can we waive or discount that for short evals? cc @elaine_dealdesk @carla_finance
ben_ops: Short answer: platform fee is separate from support. For POCs under 90 days we sometimes waive it, but that needs deal desk + finance ok. Support credits don't cover platform fee. :thinking_face:
carla_finance: Finance note: we can offer a POC credit (up to $30k) tied to a post-POC commit. For on‑prem installs, there is also an NRE line (deployment + KMS) — prefer to bill that as professional services. Invoicing: split platform fee as a one-time line item so accounting tracks it.
darren_eng: Technical caveats: on‑prem requires KMS/HSM integration, runbook handoff, and an install window — that’s typically SOW work and hourly or flat NRE. VPC evals are cheaper ops-wise.
elaine_dealdesk: Deal Desk perspective: we can approve a platform fee waiver conditioned on either (a) named reference + exec sponsor, or (b) a 12‑month dedicated commit or an equivalent minimum ARR threshold. Full waiver needs an exception ticket and VP signoff.
anya_sales: Proposed commercial: waive platform fee for a 90‑day POC if they sign a 12‑month Dedicated commit @ $200k/yr, include Standard support, Premier as a +20% add‑on. Thoughts?
carla_finance: That structure is workable from finance if legal approves the discount matrix and we capture the 12‑month PO/commit up front. We'll need the exact SKU lines to model revenue recognition. Example invoice lines: `ONE-TIME: Platform Fee (waived if commit)` / `REC: Dedicated (12m) $200,000` / `ADD: Premier Support +20%`.
darren_eng: I'll draft the tech appendix + SOW items (install checklist, KMS tasks, acceptance criteria). Will put effort estimate in hours so PS can price the NRE correctly.
elaine_dealdesk: Please open a deal desk ticket with the proposed terms and attach SOW + draft quote. I'll queue it for approval tomorrow morning. If you want the waiver, include customer name, exec sponsor, and expected timeline.
anya_sales: Thanks all — I'll draft the SOW + updated quote now, attach the security questionnaire answers and ping legal. Will update this thread once submitted. :thumbsup:
